reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text:
We had our Christmas party with over 65 employees, my staff was excited, however the service was bad, the food was cold and not tasty, and it was very expensive. 
I will not recommend this place or will we return, what a shame.

reviews.title: Cool Cuba Vibes for Brunch + Chill
reviews.text: Super cool lounge area inside and out. Great decor -very Cuba /Caribbean feels. Good mimosas and brunch. The outside seating was fun with fire pits and tropical vibes close to the pool area.
reviews.author: blwolfey

reviews.title: Cool vibe relaxing club
reviews.text: Beautiful relaxing resort club. Lounge seating, firepits, dining, bar area, music. Great place to relax with friends.
reviews.author: Janet

reviews.title: This is a fun bar with great bartenders!
reviews.text: This is a great bar located inside The Scott Resort & Spa in Scottsdale, AZ. This is the second time my wife have gone there for drinks during a weekend getaway. Both times have been awesome. The drinks are creative and taste great, and the bartenders are always friendly and funny. I feel bad that I didn't get the names of the bartenders working during our first visit, but I made a point to get the names this time. Mike and Aria were the bartenders there this last trip, and they totally deserve a shout out. We will definitely go back.
reviews.author: Crawford B

reviews.title: Bottomless brunch
reviews.text:
Went to canal club today for a bottomless brunch.  Food was great, drinks were great, and service was brilliant from Eden & Olivia.
Thanks!
reviews.author: liammc1982

reviews.title: Awful Service
reviews.text: The decor is amazing. The Pan Roasted Snapper was really good. However, Talia our server was dreadful. Pretty girl but she does not have the personality, energy or common sense to be a server. And I don't know who approved her to train someone else. I left no tip because it's not my job to do your job. She doesn't follow instructions well, she forgot multiple things on two different guest orders, she did not engage with us much, disappeared for extreme amounts of time. She could care less about her job and it was very noticeable when we visited on the evening of the 17th. One star for the decor, one star for the food and that's it because the service was awful.
reviews.author: Constance J

reviews.title: Blackened potatoes  not so good
reviews.text: This was a mistake as we were looking for a descent breakfast.  What we got was burnt cubes of potato with two eggs each.  What is this?  Why can't the cook see that the potatoes were way over done?  We were hungry so we ate what we could.  Way over-rated place.
reviews.author: 5Roses

reviews.title: Patio dining with great good and drinks.
reviews.text: Party of six including an infant and 5 year old.  Accommodated us perfectly. Patio dining. Beautiful location.  Great food and service. I had Eggs Benedict and they were so good.  Served on a plantain rather than English muffin.  The hotel is very pretty and we have decided we have to stay here to enjoy such pretty pools!  Sandy beach on one.  Walking distance to the mall!!  Lots of kids entertainment in this area of Scottsdale.
reviews.author: 144Y

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: We had dinner here and were very disappointed. The place is very beautiful, and the service is friendly and helpful. The restaurant was a bit too dark, but very comfortable and modern. The food was subpar. We ordered three different types of tacos and all were awful. The skirt stake was rubbery... we ordered the green chile chicken Oaxacan pizza, but could not find any green chile in it. The drinks were great and the churro dessert was fabulous. parking is limited and can be challenging if the place is busy. e will not retunr.
reviews.author: JRMADA

reviews.title: Great spur of the moment stop!
reviews.text: We needed a place in walking distance that was casual-but-not-too-casual to just have a nice first night on vacation.  Our server was very kind and efficient, and they were willing to serve as if we were eating Tapas.  The food was just really good!
reviews.author: Janelle

reviews.title: Really good experience. I will be coming back again!
reviews.text: Came for a bottomless brunch on Thursday, service was amazing. They do really nice Hugo spritz and had the chose of either gin and any mixer or vodka with any mixer which kept the group going!
reviews.author: Journey53597742981

reviews.title: Megan!!!!!
reviews.text: The service by Megan was top standard amazingggggg! Great value for money! Anyone wanting a decent bottomless, come here!!!!!!
reviews.author: Hannahmarie96

reviews.title: Bottomless brunch
reviews.text: Alix was amazing, good food and good drink. Did bottomless brunch really good worth the money. Free tequila shorts when sitting
reviews.author: Hannah W

reviews.title: Bottomless Brunch
reviews.text: Such a great day out! Alix was so helpful and made sure our glasses were always topped up! Would highly recommend for a girls bottomless brunch day out in Leeds!
reviews.author: Leah D

reviews.title: Skip this One
reviews.text: This was highly recommended to a person in our party, so we came for brunch on a Saturday. Meh. Service was very slow and they were not busy at all. Food very bland and flavorless.  At least the valet was free.
reviews.author: Staci T

reviews.title: Beautiful location
reviews.text: Beautiful location, there were so many different areas you could hang out and the restaurant was wonderful. Overall everyone in my group enjoyed it
reviews.author: Victoria L

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text:
The Canal Club what a beautiful restaurant inside a incredible hotel.  Jesse did a great job, service and the dinning experience was fun.
I WOULD RECOMMEND
reviews.author: CindyLou2262

reviews.title: Cozy & Tasty
reviews.text: SO cozy and beautiful inside. The food was SUPER good and my espresso martini was drool worthy.  10/10 recommend!
reviews.author: Jess

reviews.title: Neuville Havana Chick in the Desert!
reviews.text: It’s billed as “a sip of Havana”… it by no means brings back the 1930s Havana, but the Canal Club located at The Scott Resort & Spa is decked out in a distinctive subtle flashy way likened to a Neo-Carribbean post-Hemingway esthetic, in-crowd Miami Beach atmosphere and with a strong under 30 driven vibe. Don’t get me wrong, we thought the Club has done a great thing here! A needed atmosphere of sophisticated neo elegance is right here to enjoy. Reminiscent of many a Rat-Pack chic and ambience as you pass through the hotel Lounge, to the Bar, then the Restaurant it is amazing to see extraordinary work done to create an inviting subdued high end island oasis setting. As for the food, I must say, the four of us visiting that evening were intrigued by the offerings.  Again, although Havana is espoused it is far, far from its cuisine but, on its own distinctive, unique, flavorful, well portions and very importantly, very, very Neuville and in an incredibly good way. It has been my experience over the years that Neuville Cuisine to many establishments just means different, here it means different but unique and the ability to take a dish to a level that is admirable, palatable and tasty – yet one can appreciate the efforts made and the accomplishment of reaching uniqueness. For a table starter we ordered a very good rendition of Ceviche of Shrimp, in Lime, and a very tasty Cucumber Pico de Gallo. Starting with appetizers, we tried their Eloté (short corn cobs elaborately dressed) with Chipotle Aioli, Tajin seasoning, Cotija, Paprika and a slightly over abundant amount of Cilantro - excellent. And, the Tostones (plantains) surrounded by smoked bacon, a black bean puree, Pico de Gallo and finally some Cotija – very, very good. My better half enjoyed the ‘Cuban’ Marinated Pork Chop which indeed if to a wee bit did have a slight background of Cuban marinade-style seasoning which they delved up with a side of Rice, Black Bean (slightly bland) along with Brussels Sprouts in a Mango Glaze – pretty good, and unique derivation of the Caribbean! I went a little more traditional to find what Chef Chris Castro could Neuville the common yard bird! Surprisingly, his Grilled Chicken offering sided by Black Beans and Rice with a slightly over-portioned Petite Green Salad was commendable. The bird’s seasoning fringed on the Dominican/Cuban/Puerto Rican realm of flavors, making it delectably distinctive. The unique  flavors persisted through desert with some very good offerings of Cheesecake Empanadas and Churro Doughnut Holes. I’ve not entered the realm of elixirs we embibed while dining, as everything tried was excellent. Have at it, The Canal Club is a must try!
reviews.author: GastroEclectico

reviews.title: 2nd update: doesn't disappoint.  Highly recommend!
reviews.text: 2nd update : I was here for restaurant week.  I had the steak, which was amazing!  I have previously been here for brunch before which was also good.  This place amazes me everytime i visit. Ambience is great, but the food is even more amazing!  My favorite though, was their dessert with gelato and brownie which was tasty!  I would definitely return again soon for some drinks :)
reviews.author: Sein

reviews.title: nice bartenders and unreal location!
reviews.text: went to canal club after a friend recommendation  as it’s quite tucked away. served by callum who recommended a couple of drinks to us who was so lovely and chatty! there was also a really lovely bouncer who check our ID’s on arrival who deserved a mention because usually bouncers are so abrupt!
reviews.author: Holly G

reviews.title: Good food, beautiful resort, service okay.
reviews.text:
The pros: The hotel is beautiful and the lobby is gorgeous.  The restaurant seating is comfortable. The food was also excellent.  Highly recommend the tostones as an appetizer. My friends had the Cubano and it looked very good.  I had a salad that was also beautifully served and was good. 
The cons: our waitress was rarely around.  I know it’s Covid and many places are short staffed but the restaurant was pretty empty that night and we ate early.  I ordered two drinks (from their menu-not drinks I made up) and they didn’t have ingredients for them.  One of the ingredients they were out of was ginger beer and the other was cinnamon.  🤔 we had dessert at the end which was okay-banana fritters and churro donut holes. I ordered a decaf coffee with mine which was barely warm and came with no sugar or cream and the waitress left before I could ask for any.  It was freezing inside the night we were there.  I had a sweater, heavy jeans and boots on and I was shivering.

I will go back because it’s a very pretty resort, and the appetizer was so good I would love to have it again.  Hopefully, they will have all the supplies and we will get a more attentive waitress.
reviews.author: cjmaggie

reviews.title: Great spot
reviews.text: This place is one of the classiest most beautiful places i ve ever been too..they had a super modern vibrant ambience witha great outdoor seating, lots of games to entertain while sipping on some nice cocktail..i would give the food a 7 just cause the sandwich came out cold yet the pizza was very good..Definitely going back again
reviews.author: mina m

reviews.title: Beautiful space for meals and bar scene
reviews.text:
We were staying at The Scott Resort.  Walk by to get to our room from the Canal Club all the time.  It is a very inviting space, very large.  Only had breakfast here, we seated ourselves.  Took the wait staff to show for a while, it was early.  Ordered the following:

Almond Butter & Banana >>> whole grain toast, roasted almond butter, bananas, cinnamon honey

Huevos al Gusto* >>> two eggs, chorizo sausage (weird casing that wasn't thoroughly pan fried), purple potato hash

Overall pretty good.  Quick so we could get going for the day.
reviews.author: Brown_Samantha

reviews.title: Great place for brunch, and drinks
reviews.text:
I am so glad I finally got to visit the canal club for some drinks.  I have previously visited this place for brunch on the weekend. It was not too busy. Was overall quiet and relaxing! Their food was simple yet tasty. They do not have any fresh fruit juice. Coffee was ok.  Avocado toast was tasty! Pancakes were large portioned.       Recently I visited for drinks in the afternoon on a weekend day with a friend.  We had a drink 🥃 with mezcal in it and it was VERY good (and very strong).  I really wanted to try their other drinks but the first drink was too strong
I couldn’t have another 😂 but I will definitely be back! Love the ambience. Staff was friendly and seating was comfortable!
reviews.author: Sein

reviews.title: Great food and ambiance!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Scott and arrived late in the evening with reservations for dinner at 8:45. Staff was attentive and very pleasant.  Food was delicious.  I would recommend the Cubano Sandwich and the   Tostones.  We loved our evening however when we tried to eat there again on our visit they were overwhelmed and could not serve us.  The bar and restaurant get very crowded and you need reservations it seems at all times.   I completely understand but just wish as a guest that there were more options for dining. 
Love the ambience and would definitely eat there again!
reviews.author: Mountains90

reviews.title: Nuevo Latino in Scottsdale.
reviews.text: This hotel affiliated restaurant offers a great bar scene to go along with some very good food. We had some crisp plantain chips with a fantastic house made guacamole in the bar with cocktails, then a delicious Gaucho Steak with a heat packed poblano chimichuri sauce and then the stellar dish of the evening, a Cubano sandwich that had to rate as one of the best sandwiches I’ve ever had. Dessert was a molten chocolate cake with dulce de Leche Ice cream. The wine list was ok, but you could find stuff to drink. Good service and nice indoor or outdoor space.
reviews.author: Martysfo

reviews.title: Cuban Inspired Wonderful
reviews.text: We ate at The Canal Club the first night of our stay at The Scott Resort because it was convenient.  It was terrific!  We subsequently returned for several meals.  All exceeded our expectations.  Please try the Tortones, a cuban-flavored bean dip served with house-pressed, fried plantains
reviews.author: Ed S

reviews.title: Chill Dinner
reviews.text: Enjoyed a nice dinner here out on the patio.  The restaurant itself is super cute with an awesome bar, very Cuba.  Cute cocktails on the menu, however wasn't too impressed with mine.  The food is great.  this is a must-see restaurant inside an amazing hotel.
reviews.author: Ashlyn F

reviews.title: Little Cuba
reviews.text: We loved our brunch here the morning after our son’s wedding. The atmosphere is fun and very old school Cuba. The options were interesting? I especially loved that the waitress had suggestions for me as I wasn’t that hungry. The little donuts were excellent and I loved my Spanish coffee. They had us at a table a bit on its own. Service was attentive. Great vibes!
reviews.author: travelernottourist

reviews.title: Drinks and Bites!
reviews.text: Creative drink menu!  And delicious bites to share in the bar area or poolside!  The vibe is hip!  The outdoor movie was entertaining!
reviews.author: Mabrading

reviews.title: Overpriced and not worth it
reviews.text: Two hour wait. We could see our drinks sitting on the bar for 30 minutes before we went and got them ourselves. The "pizza" was soggy because it was a tortilla crust, which was not mentioned on the menu. There are a TON of great options outside the resort, so save your money and go out!
reviews.author: Caitlin C

reviews.title: Chill vibes, good brunch!
reviews.text: I visited The Canal Club twice — once for lunch and another time for brunch. The vibe is laidback and the property has an indoor-outdoor layout that's airy with lots of greenery. This place is an Instagram haven. Personally, I enjoyed brunch more than lunch — the Creole French Toast is delicious. I also liked the Leek Sofrito Revuelto, which has eggs, chorizo, and Oaxaca cheese — it was savory and not too salty. Another favorite was the Almond Butter & Banana Toast — some call it basic, but I think the cinnamon honey did the trick for me. Food aside, the staff was friendly and willing to assist at a moment's notice.
reviews.author: Traveling with Jessica

reviews.title: Nice casual lunch
reviews.text: Nice atmosphere and the employees were very friendly. We ate on the patio, even though it was rather cool. This was a birthday lunch for my friend. The wine was very good. My chicken sandwich was excellent. My friend had the pizza & it was different but I didn’t taste it since it was not appealing to me and I love pizza. There was not a birthday treat but that was OK since we were very full.
reviews.author: Lily30301

reviews.title: Some really good food!
reviews.text: Good food, great service.  The atmosphere was very comfortable but, most noteworthy was we found the wait staff to be extremely friendly and attentive.  Kudos for the care given to us every time we dined there.
reviews.author: khandibrock

reviews.title: Yuck!
reviews.text: We went once for breakfast and that was it.   The coffee was horrible.  We had the Peruvian Hash and it was really bad, over cooked and just yuck!   I don't get the reviews on this place?
reviews.author: pacnw2018

reviews.title: Beautiful Place Yummy Food
reviews.text:
Food was excellent and very yummy will return there again ... even though they have a branch on Saturday i was able to order the beautiful and delicious Autumnal Squash salad OMGatos!! that was so good! I am not a salad eater but i can say i will eat this salad anytime !!! yes it was that good !
The cuban sandwich tasted a bit like a dirty greasy grill (didn’t like it at all)

Staff members were very professional and very accommodating!! 

This place has very easy access even for handicapped people, beautiful gardens with hidden romantic sitting areas and pool area everywhere was clean and beautiful.
Thank  you!
reviews.author: mujercitass

reviews.title: Lunch alfresco
reviews.text: This restaurant has indoor and outdoor seating, do eat outdoors food is excellent with a cuban flare. The nearby pool offers great people watching
reviews.author: Ken M

reviews.title: Very nice ambiance and good foos
reviews.text:
My friend and I had a nice dinner at The Canal Club. It’s located in a beautiful resort in Scottsdale. The entrance is inviting and the bar/restaurant was full of people enjoying their time. 
I ordered the crispy skin salmon which was cooked perfectly. The accompanying Peruvian potatoes were nice. I was not very impressed with the fried plantains, although it’s popular among customers. 
Our waiter Will was very nice and energetic. He did a great job describing the dishes.
We definitely enjoyed ourselves there and I would recommend the Canal Club, whether you’re dining with a group of friends, family or significant other.
reviews.author: Alexis B

reviews.title: Amazing experience!
reviews.text: We were in town for 3 nights and we came back here everyday! Katia was our bartender all 3 times, and she is a true artist with her cocktails! They were some of the best drinks we have ever had, and she made each one with a smiling face and engaging conversation.  We will definitely be back! Thanks for a great experience!!!!!
reviews.author: mikaelaABQ

reviews.title: Lunch
reviews.text: I was reluctant to try this spot because it was located inside of a hotel. Turns out I had nothing to worry about!  This restaurant provides excellent  service, has very nice menu selections and a comfortable, casual environment. The quality of food was fresh, well prepared and very good quality. The portions were nice size, well presented and fairly priced. Looking forward to bringing friends back with us.
reviews.author: Judy F

reviews.title: Creative menu & great service!
reviews.text:
Last time we loved it so we had to check out this place again, this time we went for lunch and it was great!

Although their breakfast menu is still our favorite, their lunch menu items were just as good. 

We started with some delicious, citrusy and tasty ceviche, nice size prawns, swimming in a fantastic cilantro and lime sauce, paired with unique plantain chips as well as blue corn chips. 

We also had their Duarte burger, w an egg on top in an English muffin-like bun. Really great flavor, perfect french fries...for the more conservative folks I’d maybe experiment with a different kind of bun, but I certainly loved it as it was!

My wife had their Halibut which was fantastic too. Proper entree portion of fish, on top of vegetable sauce with hints of olive flavors, very good! See photos 

For desert we enjoyed their beautiful brownie with dulce de leche ice cream and edible flowers. This would’ve been THE perfect one if the brownie was a bit warm :p Service was so great that I’m sure you can ask them to warm it up for you no problem :)

The place is also hip and very cool! although there are a few cultural faux-pas regarding their country identity, names, and branding...as in confusing Argentina with Cuba in so many places XD ...to illustrate my point: Duarte, Boca & Estancia are as Argentinian as their flag, soccer team, and neighborhood in the heart of Buenos Aires, while their decor and rest of the brand is definitely tropical 50s Havana...not a biggie, everything else works great in this resort. 

Definitely check out this hidden gem in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Verdu Eats

reviews.title: Girls trip
reviews.text:
Great place! 
Wait staff at the pool was especially helpful. Shout out to Michael at the pool for exceptional service - he made sure all our requests were addressed. Definitely recommend. Thank you!
reviews.author: Shubmp

reviews.title: PERFECT
reviews.text: We stayed at the Scott Resort and absolutely loved Canal Club.  The food was so reasonably priced, that unlike most hotels, you don't actually want to leave You could easily enjoy all your meals here.  For Breakfast, the Overnight Oats and the Granola Bowl were delicious, for lunch, the Salads were amazing.  The ambiance was picture perfect, and there were all different types of fun seating.  Staff were so friendly, especially Doug who made are stay unforgettable.   Also the mixed drinks are amazing.
reviews.author: Meghan S

reviews.title: The Canal Club - Such a disappointment :(
reviews.text:
How unfortunate that The Canal Club turned out to be such a disappointment. Having stayed there over the Christmas holidays, my wife and I were so excited to return.  The hotel is absolutely stunning with so much consideration put into all the décor. The indoor and outdoor space of the resort is fantastic and the same goes for the restaurant itself. It really is beautifully done. That being said, the food at the restaurant didn’t even remotely live up to our expectations. There were four of us dining this evening and three of the meals sad to say were mediocre at best.  The biggest issue with the food was that it was served lukewarm and seemed rushed in the presentation. Two of us had the duck, which resembled pulled-pork more than anything else. I’ve had duck numerous times at different establishments and I’ve never seen it done this way. The two portions were cold and disproportioned in size. My wife had the Gaucho steak and found it very disappointing as well. The steak came with two potato pucks, which were dry and unnecessary. Perhaps a flavorful vegetable would be nice. The crispy skin salmon apparently was delicious but having three out of the four meals be such a huge disappointment I can’t give the restaurant more than a two star rating. The service was great (one star), overall décor/ambiance of the space (another star) but that’s about it. 

I just want to stress that WE LOVE this hotel and will 100% return. But I hate to say that when we return we will definitely be dining elsewhere. Luckily Scottsdale has so many fantastic establishments to choose from. 

PS – The ceviche was also mediocre.
reviews.author: Bartholomew N

reviews.title: Scottsdale’s hidden culinary gem
reviews.text:
Our stay that The Scott was great but wasn’t complete until we found their restaurant. 

Their menu offers a creative and delicious fusion of traditional Cuban, Mexican, and Latin flavors that feature a dish for every taste. 

We had a fantastic breakfast! Their avocado toast with 2 properly poached eggs on top and pickled pinions should be the gold standard for this dish. We also ordered their Peruvian Hash, served on a bed of delicious purple potato hash, two eggs on top pumped up by a delicious jalapeño hollandaise sauce and a choice of braised pork or green chile chicken. Absolutely gorgeous!

Because we also enjoy dessert for breakfast we ordered their tres leches jar filled with coconut mousse and topped with homemade granola. Delicious too! 

Definitely check this place if you’re around Scottsdale, let me know if you like it too ei? :D
reviews.author: Verdu Eats

reviews.title: The Canal Club - Wowzers
reviews.text:
My wife and I just had a date night here based on a suggestion from a friend. Prior to this I had never heard of it. I do have to say the food and service was amazing. 

The decor and atmosphere was so cool. It made me feel like I traveled back in time. I assume this was Havana inspired.

We ordered cocktails, mine was a coconut mojito, don't remember the name, but I do remember it was fantastic. We then started with an appetizer, the ceviche, and it is probably the best ceviche I've had. It came with regular corn chips and some plantain chips. I've never had plantain chips before and I was pleasantly surprised at how delightful they are.

For dinner I ordered the Duck and Domplines. I don't always do duck, but when I do... It will be at the Canal Club. The entree has dark meat duck, domplines, mushrooms, onions, baby heirloom carrots all in this amazing plantain alfredo sauce... yum. Mouth is watering typing this up. My wife ordered a crispy salmon dish that I also had to sample. Yes it also was divine. 

On to desert: We shared the Ancho Chocolate Brownie... yes please... Perfectly crisp on the outside, warm and moist on the inside, with some dulce de leche gelato on top and black berries mixed in. This was so mouth watering good, totally worth the cheat meal. 

The service could not have been better. Our server was very attentive and tremendously knowledgeable. There wasn't a time we needed her and she wasn't there. She must've had every meal there to know so much detail! I believe her name was Elena! Elena of the Canal Club!

Overall, very impressed. I would definitely recommend this place to my friends and we WILL be going back. It seems like a great place to hang out with friends too.
reviews.author: Terence H

reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: Decided to drop in for dinner while in the Old Town area, having not dined here before.  The fried plantains, shrimp ceviche, scallops and filet were amazing.  The chef came out personally to make sure we enjoyed his handiwork.  All of which were upstaged by the brownie and mango cranberry cobbler.  The Spanish Latte was fantastic, too.  It was a great place for date night, the patio was a nice relaxed atmosphere.
reviews.author: Tom G

reviews.title: YUMMY DRINKS and FOOD
reviews.text:
Benny makes the best drinks ever!!!
Also their chicken tortilla soup, Ceviche and cobb salad was so good. we had their breakfast sandwich for breakfast as well and it was yummy. I was unsure about the potato hash since its purple potato but it was really good, we were very surprised. They do not disappoint on their ceviche either, its loaded with shrimp.
reviews.author: Lindsleo15

reviews.title: Good Setting But Needs a little help!
reviews.text: The open air dinning room is fabulous - surrounded by palm trees. It is a wonderfully Caribbean setting. Service was slow but OK. We ordered the salmon toast which mad the trip worthwhile. However, it was downhill from there. After a tasty tropical concoction was ordered some rose. The server presented us with two glasses of vinegar (turned rose)! We reordered and were served lunch/dinner. The much totted duck was mediocre and the scallops were just OK. Frankly, I would return for lunch and try the sandwiches. They looked delicious and a better value.
reviews.author: D&L

reviews.title: Love the Cuban Style Breakfast...
reviews.text:
We visited for breakfast, and were surprised how cozy the outdoor seating was.  This restaurant is nestled inside The Scott Resort, which looks quite nice actually.  The hotel and restaurant have a Tasteful Cuban vibe going on, and they pull it off.

Menu was awesome, with nice breakfast options not found on most breakfast menus.  Absolutely loved my simple eggs and yummy bacon, with the arugula side salad - dressing is amazing.  The restaurant manager was assisting the attentive wait staff, and making sure things were flowing well on a busy Saturday morning, which bodes well with us.

We’ve been coming to Scottsdale for around 5 years now, and The Canal Club is the clear breakfast winner!  We’ll be back for sure.
reviews.author: Dave T

reviews.title: Just ok
reviews.text: I have been wanting to go to this restaurant since I read a newspaper article on September 2018, and the writer describes the place as "Exudes a 1930s Havana vibe", there is nothing Havana vibe, the cocktails although very good, are not made with Bacardi Rum, which is a staple to any Cuban restaurant. The food was ok, the Cuban Sandwich was delicious, but is not the traditional "Cuban", this is nothing but an average hotel restaurant. The service started excellent and went down the hill, where our server was nowhere to be seen, I think the staff was reduced and he was covering too many tables
reviews.author: doraniamato

reviews.title: Delish!
reviews.text: Stylish, creative, healthy, and beautifully presented - food and design.  Loved every meal here from the farro bowl and salads to the heartier French toast and hamburgers. Ask them to go lighter on the salt and you have perfection.
reviews.author: GoGoIrene

reviews.title: Business lunch, average food, average service
reviews.text: Went here for a business lunch, 11:30 am.  Sat outside.  Waited forever for wait staff, table hadn't been bused well and the previous dining receipt was still on table.  Had to constantly ask for a refill on water.  Salad was good.   It's a pretty simple menu.  Remember, it's in a hotel, so you'll have to valet park.
reviews.author: Pittsburghparents

reviews.title: Great food in a wonderful setting
reviews.text: We ate lunch at The Canal Club and the food and service was amazing.  We also loved the setting and atmosphere of the restaurant.  Cannot wait to go back when it is a little cooler and can enjoy the outside patio which looked fabulous.
reviews.author: bekkifeil

reviews.title: Petite escapade à Cuba
reviews.text: Le décor joue sur la thématique caribéenne, normal ce restaurant ce trouve au sein de l’hôtel Scottsdale resort and Spa architecturé sur ce style. L’accueil est chaleureux et professionnel. Les clients sont de l’hôtel ou extérieurs. La carte est assez courte mais c’est un gage de qualité et de fraîcheur. Les plats sont bien garnis et très bien cuisinés. L’équilibre épices, mets est parfait. Un choix de vins au verre est disponible. Bien sûr les bières sont de la fête pour les amateurs de houblons. En résumé une soirée parfaite en amoureux, ambiance assez cosy et pour plus de tranquillité demandez les tables proche baie vitrée. La note est à l’avenant, donc ne vous attendez pas à un restaurant entrée de gamme. Mais le rapport qualité prix est au rendez vous !
reviews.author: Yves Michel L

reviews.title: breakfast was good
reviews.text: Our breakfast service was slow and most of the time there was no one around. But the food was ok, just pricey.
reviews.author: jyoung3095

reviews.title: Nice break away from home
reviews.text: The menu is not huge but the place is fabulous . Everyone is attentive and the hotel it’s based in is fabulous . Love this place
reviews.author: louiseanne6

reviews.title: Tasty breakfast!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our breakfast at the hotel.  We had the French toast with coconut whip cream and the breakfast sandwich (get the potatoes as your side).
reviews.author: dsteele526

reviews.title: "Relax Setting"
reviews.text: Small bar inside The Scott Resort has a nice atmosphere. The area outside near the pool is where you want to be with the music and comfortable chairs to unwind. Food options are limited but very good.
reviews.author: jaylbay

reviews.title: Stepped into Cuba (in Scottsdale)
reviews.text: The Canal Club is my new favorite restaurant in all of The Valley. The menu is spot on Cuban and the food is SO perfectly executed (not to mention the awesome hand crafted drinks)! If you are looking for a great and unique dining experience this is your spot!!!! From the decor to the music to the delicious food, this place has it all! Ask for Will too, he’s the best of the best!!
reviews.author: macey2951

reviews.title: A classy and unique flavor
reviews.text:
Dinner! Was! AMAZING! We sat inside against the patio and enjoyed the beautiful ambiance. The beautiful decor inside, soft lighting and music made me feel like I was in Miami! We started with plantains and for my entree I had the salmon. It was superb! Probably the best Salmon I have had in AZ.  I fell in love with their drink menu....It was super cute and well done. Our server was Will and he was personable, professional and didn’t rush us!  He is a PRO. For dessert.....well I couldn’t decide on one. So we had the Cuban donut holes and the tres leches. What a perfect ending to an awesome dinner.  Right at the entrance of the restaurant is the bar! The bright pink bar logo is super fun and the openness of the bar and lobby is very welcoming. Felt like I Wish people were salsa dancing! 

Afterwards, I was so full I just wanted to walk the gorgeous grounds. The lush hotel had huge beautiful trees with Moroccan themed metal lanterns hanging from them. Soft hammocks positioned and nestled in little pockets....they were calling my name!

I can’t wait come back here! It’s my “happy place” the staff is personable! The hotel is so lovely and relaxing and the rooms were incredibly done. Scottsdale’s GEM!
reviews.author: HGISCOTTSDALE

reviews.title: Great Food
reviews.text: The Cuban Sandwich is great!! One of the best I've ever had! The menu is pretty limited. The breakfast menu contains a "purple potato hash" wish was pretty tasteless, but the eggs and bacon were cook to the requested specifications.
reviews.author: MrsLive4ever

reviews.title: cute place with good desserts
reviews.text: We went to the Canal Club for a nice dinner. The meal was good but I enjoyed the desserts a bit more.
reviews.author: 48kwant

reviews.title: Average service and food
reviews.text: We ate early dinner. Service was slow. Food was average. We stayed at the hotel so we gave it a try.
reviews.author: Paul C

reviews.title: A nice dinner
reviews.text: Went to dinner at this location.  It is located in a lovely hotel lobby - the atmosphere is very southern and breezy.  The menu is a bit sparse, I expected a lot more variety.  The appetizers were good - the service was excellent.
reviews.author: Melanna

reviews.title: Great Food
reviews.text: Stayed at the resort for a business meeting with 150+ attendees and pleasantly surprised at the quality of the food for every service. The ability of this location was excellent whether it was a group of 6 or 200. The Canal Club offers great service and and food. Thank you for the experience.
reviews.author: Divexcl50

reviews.title: Friends weekend
reviews.text: Rooms were perfect size. The bathroom was layed out perfect for ladies sharing a room. Lots of fire pits to sit with cocktails from the Canal Club.  Had brunch at Canal Club. Was awesome. Mimosas perfect the grounds were beautiful. Bar by the pool. Shuttle bus was a plus.
reviews.author: beckyhunter038

reviews.title: Good breakfast
reviews.text: Limited  menu but great quality food.  A bit on the pricey side.  Staff was very friendly and attentive.
reviews.author: redstackpmc

reviews.title: Really good!
reviews.text: We had lunch the afternoon of our arrival and breakfast the next morning. Both meals were delicious, but the breakfast—the Peruvian bowl—was AMAZING! Normally, breakfast is a by-the-numbers thing, but not at the Canal Club. Here, it’s an experience to be treasured. I cannot recommend it highly enough. Lunch is fine, but breakfast is a dream! The host and staff are great, too!
reviews.author: MApropism

reviews.title: The pizza!!!!
reviews.text:
We got into town on Thanksgiving and didn't plan dinner ahead of time since we didn't know what time we would be getting in. We quickly found out NOWHERE was open for dinner and opted to eat at our hotel. We sat at the bar section (slightly different menu) and shared the verde chicken pizza and argula pear salad. SOOOO good! The black bean spread on the pizza was amazing - were going to try and recreate it at home because we can't stop dreaming about it. 
Service was a bit slow for how few people were there but oh well!
reviews.author: Colette N

reviews.title: Yay!
reviews.text:
We are guests at the Scott, checked in later than expected, had been here before when the property was a Kimpton and suddenly were VERY hungry.  

So OF COURSE we could have a late lunch.  And sit outdoors.  The menu was great, we ordered well, the service was very nice.  The landscaping is lovely and mature and we felt we had the place all to ourselves.

So, why go anywhere else?
reviews.author: perromore

reviews.title: Fantastic Find!
reviews.text: I stopped into the Scott Hotel to check out their new renovations.  The hotel Is simply breathtaking!  The lobby has a tropical motif reminiscent of Old Havana/ Florida Keys.  That’s when I noticed the restaurant in the back of the lobby.  It looked inviting enough, so I thought, why not?  What a great surprise!  The menu has a Cuban flare.  Cocktails are inventive and mostly tequila or rum based. While there are more traditional food entrees on the menu, I opted for the Cubano, a Cuban sandwich made from ham and roast beef.  It could be one of the most delicious sandwiches I’ve ever had in my life!  To top off the experience, the waiter, Will was professional, polite, funny and knowledgeable.  I will definitely return!
reviews.author: Bill D
